description: Capability for the main window. Includes core:window:allow-start-dragging because the window hides its title bar and is dragged via data-tauri-drag-region elements: Tauri's drag script invokes plugin:window|start_dragging, which core:window:default does NOT grant (it grants only allow-internal-toggle-maximize, the double-click-to-maximize half). Without it the ACL denies the call silently and the window cannot be moved.
